prompt: I contribute to a project from my own fork. `upstream` is the main repo and `origin` is my fork. I want git-stack to pull main from upstream but push my feature branches to origin. How do I configure that, and then how do I push my ready branch? Commands please.

assertions.text: Uses `git-stack --push` to publish after configuring remotes
Does not confuse the two remotes (pull=upstream/shared, push=origin/fork)
